meta.description: All six Terror Tales of the Park, Regular Show's Halloween anthology specials.
meta.name: Regular Show

videos.name: Terror Tales of the Park
videos.overview: Mordecai and Rigby discover an old Victorian Doll that Pop’s has not played with or seen since he was a child and unwittingly unleash its pent up rage against him. Muscle Man and High Five Ghost want to crash an old RV into a pit.

videos.name: Terror Tales of the Park II
videos.overview:
The group passes time by telling each other scary stories while driving to a Halloween party.
 • "Payback" – Mordecai's deceased uncle haunts him after accidentally knocking him into the ball return at a bowling alley.
 • "Party Bus" – Mordecai, Rigby, Margaret, and Eileen board a haunted bus where they find the passengers aging as the bus moves forward and have to try to escape.
 • "Wallpaper Man" – Mordecai and Rigby hire a man to re-wallpaper the house, but they quickly find out that he is a giant evil spider, and they struggle to defeat him.

videos.name: Terror Tales of The Park III
videos.overview: The group makes a bet over who can tell the scariest story at their Halloween party.

videos.name: Terror Tales of the Park IV
videos.overview: The park workers try to keep Muscle Man awake by telling him scary stories in the car while driving to visit his mother.

videos.name: Terror Tales of the Park V
videos.overview: Benson tries to spice up the park's annual Halloween party by renting a wish making machine.

videos.name: Terror Tales of the Park VI
videos.overview: The gang tells scary stories with a science fiction twist.
